what: Free local retouch of v4 (no model call): the v4 fix left a semi-transparent ghost of the v3 open case lid on the wall around the new closed brass case. Inside the mask (game px x 0-228, y 0-112, above the shelf line y = 108 + 0.337 x, minus the hand-traced case silhouette dilated 2 px) the wall was replaced by a 31 px median of the wall tone (case pixels pre-filled with the wall mean) plus synthetic grain matched to the wall (sigma 2.9), feathered 3 px, then resampled into master geometry and composited onto v4; all other pixels are identical to v4.
